name: Mu
epithet: Young wanderer searching for her mother
personality: Childlike and innocent, presenting as a boy to protect herself on the road.
story: Mu (14-15 pre-timeskip) left home to find her missing mother, Mikaela, and met Leda along the way. She joins Leda's route automatically; on other routes she needs Support 3, 3x Glirmosa, and Renown 9+ (Cai/Theodora) or 7+ (Dietrich). She has a support with Mikaela.

personalSkill.name: Signs of Growth
personalSkill.effect: Grants enhanced basic stat growth on each level-up. Lv 20: Warrior's Blood (stat boost per equipped weapon type); Lv 35: Warrior's Blood+.

tierNotes: Pocket Tactics: A. KeenGamer: S (Signs of Growth makes her one of the best physical spreads). fortunesweave.co.uk rates her ability 5/5.

why: Joins Leda's army with the story in Ch 1 (join class and level not documented): no Support or Renown to chase.

path: Warrior (Part II Ch 1 to 2 side trip: Practiced Art)
build.notes: Pugilist is home (Spd 60, Def 50, Brawl Avo +3). Short trips for masteries only: Brigand for Regroup, Warrior for Practiced Art. Every rank to B from the Arena Warrior course. War Monk in Part III.

guide.summary: The army's dodge tank. Bait enemy phase with [[item:Wooden Gauntlets]] +5 and the [[item:Gale Ring]], and open each player phase with an art so [[ability:Attack, Get Back]] adds Avo +10. Signs of Growth boosts every level-up, so feed her kills early: she ends as a hard-hitting [[class:War Monk]] who heals after combat.
guide.playstyle: Stand on forests and forts at the front; check every forecast before ending her turn and keep a Physic healer in range. Sing Icewater over her only on enemy phases she can't dodge.
keys: Take [[class:Pugilist]] at Lv 20 in Ch 6 and keep it as her home class
Buy [[item:Wooden Gauntlets]] in Daimon (300G, by 5/28); refine to +5 in Ch 6
Open every attack with an art: [[ability:Attack, Get Back]] adds Avo +10
Seat her in the Arena Warrior course weekly: Gauntlet, Axe, Sword B by 11/27
Spend Ch 7 to 8 in [[class:Brigand]] for [[ability:Regroup]], then back to Pugilist
watch: Weight: Iron Gauntlets +4 3 + Gale Ring 2 = 5, no Spd from the gauntlets; Circles turns 4 + 2 = 6
Res: 30%. Avo works vs magic too, but a mage hit lands harder: check the forecast
Growth: Signs of Growth adds to each level-up (size ?), so she beats the printed rows
Inventory: 4 core (gauntlets, circles, ring, heal); Salamander and Juice for Part II Ch 5
Ddg: Avo isn't crit avoid. Miranilla Juice (Ddg +5) on crit-heavy boss maps

decisions.topic: Keep Pugilist as her home class
decisions.pick: Pugilist, with short trips out for masteries
decisions.why: Pugilist grows Spd 60, Def 50 and HP 65, adds Brawl Avo +3 and keeps her gauntlets. Warrior grows Spd 50 and Def 45, so she visits it only for Practiced Art.
decisions.else: Warrior as home if you'd rather have HP and Str 70 than Avo

decisions.topic: Take the Brigand trip for Regroup
decisions.pick: Brigand, Ch 7 to 8, once Attack, Get Back is mastered
decisions.why: [[ability:Regroup]] (Avo +20 for the combat when a foe avoids her attack) fires after Feint's Hit −50 misses and stays in her slots to Part III. Her ranks come from the Arena, not this trip.
decisions.else: Skip it if the Pugilist mastery runs late; Attack Basics keeps the slot

decisions.topic: Take a Part II Warrior stint
decisions.pick: Warrior, Part II Ch 1 to 2, for Practiced Art
decisions.why: [[ability:Practiced Art]] (Hit +10 on arts) covers Feint and Battle Rush on every player phase. Needs Gauntlet, Axe and Sword B by 11/27 from the Arena: Part II has none.
decisions.else: Stay Pugilist if Axe or Sword misses B

routeNotes.note: Partners here: Leda, Sirocco, Buccar, Olympia, Guzran and Mikaela (filler). Meal seat: Leda + Mu + Guzran (all three pairs support).
Icewater (Def/Res +4, +7 after Captain's) on enemy phases she can't dodge. She has no sword: undead go down inside Leda's Abjuring ring.
Wooden Gauntlets in Daimon (by 5/28); Qiankun Circles and the Gale Ring barter on the Dance for Alecto trip (Ch 7).
Arena Warrior course every week from Ch 5 (Sword, Axe, Gauntlet); Mage course on spare weeks for White D.
